name: avatar_onboard
description: Full avatar onboarding: validate market position → assess content strategy → draft launch merch → produce launch plan. Creator brings a character concept, we return a positioned, validated, monetizable launch plan. Human approves before anything goes live.

launch_ready.description: Is this avatar ready to launch? Consider: distinctive voice, clear niche with audience demand, viable format, realistic cadence the creator can sustain.

biggest_risk.description: What is the single biggest risk to this avatar succeeding?

first_move.description: What should happen first: publish content to build audience, launch merch to test demand, grow audience on existing platform, or reposition the character?

steps.label: build-launch-plan
steps.code: s => { const m = s.market || {}; const f = s.fit || {}; const ready = !!f.launch_ready && (m.total || 0) >= 50; let verdict = 'NOT_READY'; if (ready && !f.biggest_risk) verdict = 'READY'; else if ((m.total || 0) >= 40) verdict = 'NEEDS_WORK'; return { plan: { avatar: s.name, handle: s.handle || '', niche: s.niche, market_score: m.total || 0, market_verdict: m.verdict || 'UNKNOWN', launch_ready: !!f.launch_ready, biggest_risk: f.biggest_risk || 'unknown', first_move: f.first_move || 'content_first', pricing: { guide: 27, bundle: 47, circle: 9.9 }, format: { length_min: s.video_length_min || 0, per_week: s.uploads_per_week || 0 }, store: s.store || 'pogtown', verdict: verdict, needs_review: true } }; }

steps.label: human-approves-launch
steps.summary: Launch plan for {plan.avatar}: {plan.verdict} (market {plan.market_score}). Risk: {plan.biggest_risk}. First move: {plan.first_move}.
